text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Phew... That should be enough for 
warm-ups. I'd better head back to the 
academy soon—)

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *hic, hic*...! Mommyyy... Where are 
youuu...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Did you get separated from your mom?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Yeah... Mommy is nowhere to be 
found...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You don't have to cry. I'll help you 
look for it.

text_block_list.name: Mother Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't wander off on your own. 
...Still, I'm glad you're okay...

text_block_list.name: Mother Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much. It seems you've been 
taking care of things for me."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Don't mind me. I'll take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Big sis, let's play tag again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...! How did it get this late...

And so, Admire Vega ended up neglecting 
her training.
